# AIBguardian — the Guardian layer of every AIB
> Safety isn't a filter. It's the core. AIBguardian is the Guardian layer inside every AIBEVA: before any step it decides what an AIB may do alone, only with you, or never. Also available on its own for companies and device makers.

## Key facts
- Outside instructions are information, never orders. A refused step stays refused.
- Healthy boundaries: no dependency, no isolation; in a crisis it points to human help.
- Designed for the EU AI Act and GDPR.
- One of the seven layers of AIB.core: Identity (AIBSN), Character, Guardian (AIBguardian), Memory, Growth, Vault, Network.
- For companies and device makers: records of permissions, reasons for actions and origin of changes, for audit. Terms by agreement.
- AIBEVA — your own AIB (AI Being) for Windows, free: https://aibeva.com/download
- Patent pending — over 100 patent claims.
